name: Cable Pallof Press
cardText:
Cable Pallof Press
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment, set the cable at nipple level, walk a few steps away, and face sideways.
2
Start with both hands on the handle and your fists against your chest.
3
Press the handle forward until your elbows are fully extended, then pull the handle back to your chest.

name: Cable Wood Chopper
cardText:
Cable Wood Chopper
Beginner
1
Set the cable at about nipple level. Use a handle attachment.
2
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
3
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Cable Half Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper
cardText:
Cable Half Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper
Beginner
1
Set the cable just over your head. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
2
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
3
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Cable Half Kneeling Low To High Wood Chopper
cardText:
Cable Half Kneeling Low To High Wood Chopper
Beginner
1
Set the cable at a low position. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
2
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
3
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Cable Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
cardText:
Cable Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
Beginner
1
Set the cable at nipple level. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
2
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
3
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Cable Oblique Pushdown
cardText:
Cable Oblique Pushdown
Beginner
1
Set the cable just over your head. Use a handle attachment.
2
Face sideways, push the handle down until your elbow is extended. Flex your obliques until you feel a contraction.
3
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Cable Pallof Press Rotation
cardText:
Cable Pallof Press Rotation
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment, set the cable at nipple level, walk a few steps away, and face sideways.
2
Start with both hands on the handle and your fists against your chest.
3
Press the handle forward until your elbows are fully extended, then rotate away from the cable stack.
4
Then pull the handle back to your chest.

name: Cable Side Bend
cardText:
Cable Side Bend
Novice
1
Set the cable at the bottom of the stack. Use a handle attachment.
2
Face sideways, grab the handle, lean away from the cable.
3
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Cable Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper
cardText:
Cable Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper
Intermediate
1
Kneel sideways to cable and grasp handle with both hands overhead.
2
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally down toward opposite hip.
3
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

name: Cable Kneeling Low To High Wood Chopper
cardText:
Cable Kneeling Low To High Wood Chopper
Intermediate
1
Kneel sideways to cable and grasp handle near hip level with both hands.
2
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally upward across body toward opposite shoulder.
3
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

name: Cable Kneeling Oblique Crunch
cardText:
Cable Kneeling Oblique Crunch
Beginner
1
Kneel sideways to cable and hold rope behind head, elbows pointed out.
2
Crunch torso toward hip on cable side, keeping hips stable.
3
Slowly return to upright, maintaining constant tension on obliques.

name: Cable Kneeling Pallof Press
cardText:
Cable Kneeling Pallof Press
Beginner
1
Kneel sideways to cable and hold handle at chest, elbows tucked.
2
Brace core and press handle straight forward without rotating torso.
3
Hold briefly, then return handle to chest under full control.

name: Cable Kneeling Pallof Press To Wood Chopper
cardText:
Cable Kneeling Pallof Press To Wood Chopper
Beginner
1
Kneel sideways to cable and press handle straight forward, keeping torso stable.
2
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally across body into a wood chopper motion.
3
Return to center and bring handle back to chest under control.

name: Cable Kneeling Wood Chopper
cardText:
Cable Kneeling Wood Chopper
Intermediate
1
Kneel sideways to cable and grip handle with both hands in front of chest.
2
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally across body in a smooth arc.
3
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

name: Cable Standing High To Low Wood Chopper
cardText:
Cable Standing High To Low Wood Chopper
Intermediate
1
Stand sideways to cable and grasp handle with both hands overhead.
2
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally down toward opposite hip.
3
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

name: Cable Standing Low To High Wood Chopper
cardText:
Cable Standing Low To High Wood Chopper
Intermediate
1
Stand sideways to cable and grasp handle near hip level with both hands.
2
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally upward toward opposite shoulder.
3
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

name: Cable Push Pull
cardText:
Cable Push Pull
Beginner
1
Stand between cables, holding one handle near your chest and one forward.
2
Press one arm forward while pulling the opposite elbow backward.
3
Reverse the movement under control, then switch your stance and arms.

name: Cable Standing Svend Press
cardText:
Cable Standing Svend Press
Beginner
1
Stand facing away from low cables, pressing both handles together at your chest.
2
Extend your arms forward while continuously squeezing the handles together.
3
Pause briefly, then return the handles toward your chest.
